AMENDMENT NO. 1 JULY 2019
TO
IS 2082 : 2018 STATIONARY STORAGE TYPE ELECTRIC
WATER HEATERS — SPECIFICATION

(Fifth Revision)

(Second cover page, Foreword) — Substitute ‘IS 302-2-21 : 2018’ for
‘IS 302-2-21 : 2011’ and wherever it appears in the standard.

(Page 4, clause 18.2) — Substitute “The mixing factor shall be as declared
by the manufacturer” for the existing clause.

(Page 5, clause 22.1.3) — Substitute the following for the existing clause:

‘22.1.3 Routine Test

The schedule of routine test shall be as given in Annex A of IS 302 (Part 1).’
